Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator failed to correctly identify the target restaurant "Shanghai Villa" which is a well-known, affordable, and highly-rated vegan-friendly Chinese restaurant located very close to Washington Square Park (on 4th Ave between 14th and 15th St, just one block east of the park). Instead, the Orchestrator's initial search focused on high-end, non-vegan Italian and American restaurants (Palma, Babbo, Knickerbocker, etc.) that are unlikely to have vegan mains under $15. This fundamental error in selecting the correct candidates led to a long, inefficient, and ultimately incorrect investigation of unsuitable restaurants. The Orchestrator should have either searched specifically for "vegan restaurants near Washington Square Park" or included "Shanghai Villa" in its initial candidate list.
